description: This file implements functions to parse command-line arguments for boolean flags, specifically handling flags with formats like -flag, --flag, -noflag, --noflag, and converting them to --flag=true or --flag=false. It includes functions to identify boolean flags and override their values in argument vectors.

classes.name: BooleanFlag
classes.description: A struct representing whether an argument is a boolean flag, its value, and its name.

methods.name: IsBoolArg
methods.description: Determines if a given argument string is a boolean flag and extracts its name and value.

methods.name: FormatBoolString
methods.description: Formats a boolean flag name and value into a string of the form '--name=true' or '--name=false'.

methods.name: OverrideBoolArg
methods.description: Iterates over a list of argument strings and overrides boolean flags with specified values based on a set of flag names.
